title: Spell Shop Entrance
description: A magical nighttime street scene featuring the arched wooden door of a Spell Shop with glowing text reading 'STASIS SPELLS - LOCKED FUSIONS ONLY'. The stone building facade is adorned with hanging scrolls, potion bottles in windows, brass bells, and wooden crates displaying framed illustrations of blue moths and glowing hands. A lit candle rests on parchment in the foreground beside old keys on a cloth.
prompt: A detailed fantasy nighttime scene of a mysterious spell shop entrance built into an old stone building. An arched wooden door displays glowing text 'STASIS SPELLS - LOCKED FUSIONS ONLY'.
